	"plan": "# Fix CRLF Git Noise\n\n## Diagnosis (from [CRLF inspection](584aaefa-7bae-45a8-a19d-43b2a381538b))\n\n- **HEAD is clean LF** — zero CRLF in committed blobs.\n- **Working tree has 25 CRLF files** (mostly `*.test.ts`, fixtures, `.gitattributes`, `.gitignore`, `LICENSE`).\n- Policy was added during the cross-platform refactor but never finalized:\n  - [`.gitattributes`](.gitattributes) already has `* text=auto eol=lf` (uncommitted; file itself is CRLF on disk)\n  - [`.editorconfig`](.editorconfig) has `end_of_line = lf` (untracked)\n- Windows **`core.autocrlf=true`** (global) fights `eol=lf` and hides many mismatches until files are edited.\n- ~27 files show as modified with **empty content diffs** (stat/mtime noise).\n\n```mermaid\nflowchart LR\n  HEAD[\"HEAD blobs LF\"] --\u003e Autocrlf[\"autocrlf=true checkout\"]\n  Autocrlf --\u003e WT[\"Working tree CRLF on 25 files\"]\n  Policy[\"eol=lf in WT .gitattributes\"] --\u003e Warn[\"git diff CRLF warnings\"]\n  WT --\u003e Warn\n  Fix[\"autocrlf=false + renormalize\"] --\u003e Clean[\"All WT LF + no warnings\"]\n```\n\n## Approach (locked)\n\n1. **Repo-local** `git config core.autocrlf false` (never touch global git config).\n2. Ensure policy files are **LF on disk**, keep existing content.\n3. Add `\"files.eol\": \"\\n\"` to [`.vscode/settings.json`](.vscode/settings.json).\n4. Run `git add --renormalize .`, then refresh index / drop empty-diff “modified” files.\n5. Verify with byte scan + `git diff` (zero CRLF warnings) + `bun fastvet`.\n6. **Do not commit** unless you ask — leave staged/working tree ready for the broader cross-platform commit.\n\n## Execution steps\n\n1. Set `core.autocrlf=false` in this repo only.\n2. Rewrite CRLF → LF for the 25 files (or rely on renormalize after policy is LF), ensuring [`.gitattributes`](.gitattributes) and [`.editorconfig`](.editorconfig) are LF.\n3. Patch [`.vscode/settings.json`](.vscode/settings.json) to include `\"files.eol\": \"\\n\"` beside existing SpecStory setting.\n4. `git add --renormalize .` then `git update-index --refresh`; for any remaining empty-diff modified files, restore/refresh so `git status` only shows real content changes from the cross-platform WIP.\n5. Acceptance checks:\n   - 0 tracked files with CR (`0x0d`) bytes\n   - `git diff` has no “CRLF will be replaced by LF” warnings\n   - Real refactor diffs still present (paths, scripts, tests, docs)\n   - `bun fastvet` exits 0\n\n## Out of scope\n\n- Committing the cross-platform refactor\n- Changing global `core.autocrlf`\n- Adding CI EOL checks\n- Fixing the unrelated `coverage-threshold.ts` inline path normalize (separate reuse nit)\n",
